==Summary==

{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

Elayne and the group from Ebou Dar arrive at the Farm. [[Alise]] arrives to meet them but notices that [[Careane]] did not pull her hood up far enough. Other women on the farm notice and a cry goes up that it is [[Aes Sedai]] and the women begin to scatter in a panic. Alise is upset with [[Reanne]], believing that she betrayed the [[Kin]]. Reanne explains that the Aes Sedai have always known about the Kin and now they are given the option to go back to the [[White Tower]]. [[Nynaeve]] sends the [[warder]]s to round up the fleeing women. [[Adeleas]] and [[Vandene]] link and take [[Ispan]] to a small side building to begin questioning, which angers Elayne since they did not ask permission. Ispan is defiant, claiming to have orders from [[Elaida]]. [[Aviendha]] threatens her but Adeleas says shedding blood during questioning is forbidden. Elayne is willing to get answers however she must from Ispan, but Vandene takes her outside and convinces her that they know the best way to proceed.

Meanwhile the scattered Kin and residents on the farm are being gathered up and settled. Elayne and Aviendha resume searching the [[Kin's Storeroom|storeroom]] stash. Two more ''[[angreal]]'' are found, a [[gold bracelet and rings]] and a [[ivory seated woman|seated woman in age-darkened ivory]]. [[Nynaeve]] arrives and tells [[Elayne]] that it is time to use the [[Bowl of the Winds]].
